text: Securing the funds to be designated to Toronto Business Development Centre is required on an urgent basis to build community capacity in advance of development and is required at this time due to the extended City Council break to ensure additional government funding for these programming and services. Assignment of Section 37 Funds for direct payment to the Toronto Business Development Centre to contribute to the purchase, build and/or make leasehold improvements of a property that can be used as a skills training hub in Scarborough Southwest to serve residents of Scarborough and to accelerate Post-COVID recovery.
